novel_mechanics_found: Level 7 introduces two paired color-15 swap sockets. The left pair is at (13,25)<->(13,13) and is activated by the autonomous color-14 runner reaching (1,25); any entity parked in one socket is transferred to the other. The right pair is at (49,37)<->(49,49) and is activated from the remote plate at (49,1). The existing color-11 toggle at (19,37) moves the runner barrier from (1,37) to (7,37), and a color-8 plate at (13,1) moves the top gate from (31,1) to (25,1). Successful moves advance runner and ghosts; blocked moves do not, but blocked moves still consume the finite level clock. Live play verified the left swap by transferring the active player from (13,25) to (13,13), verified clone parking on (13,1) opens the top gate, and verified that commits rewind the runner and replayable ghosts while preserving their programs.
narrative: The mandated precondition used resolve_replay_plan({'game':'g50t','levels_reproduced':6}, Path('.')), a brand-new arc.make('g50t') environment, and exactly one reset. Replaying all 288 banked labels reached frame_level 6. L7 was then mapped live with compact state/component dumps. Early direct-goal probes established that the goal region is disconnected: downward approaches from (31,37) are blocked. The runner initially bounces at the closed color-11 barrier; stepping on (19,37) toggled that barrier open, after which the runner reached (1,25). Synchronizing the player on (13,25) with that arrival transferred it live to (13,13). Moving to (13,1) and committing produced a clone program; replaying it parked clone 1 on the color-8 plate and moved the top barrier open. A second 50-move exploratory program was committed toward the far-right trigger. The final replay timed out at ucorwtereb=130 before those overlong exploratory programs completed, so no level advance is claimed. The action_sequence field intentionally contains a compact 43-action L7 candidate derived after the timeout, not the failed 131-label exploratory tail: clone 1 uses DOWN,DOWN,LEFT,RIGHT,UP,UP,LEFT,LEFT,UP,UP,ACTION5; clone 2 concurrently routes through the gate and commits on (49,1); the active run routes to (49,37) on the same tick clone 2 reaches (49,1), then proposes LEFTx3 from the swapped (49,49) endpoint to the goal. This compact candidate was not executed or reproduction-gated and must be treated as a hypothesis for outer-loop verification.
gotchas: The precondition gate used a brand-new environment followed by exactly one reset and reproduced level 6 in 288 labels.
L7 has a hard clock: the exploratory episode entered GAME_OVER at ucorwtereb=130; blocked inputs consume this clock even though they do not advance the runner or recorded trajectory.
The left color-15 mechanism is a paired socket swap, not an ordinary hold-open plate; activation transfers current socket occupants between (13,25) and (13,13).
The right pair must be phase-synchronized: an entity must occupy (49,37) when a different entity first activates (49,1), otherwise the swap fires on empty sockets.
The color-11 runner barrier is toggle-latched. It must be opened early enough for the runner to cross from (1,43) to (1,37) and reach the left swap trigger.
ACTION5 records only successful moves in the ghost program, but still consumes one clock action. The compact candidate removes all exploratory blocked moves.
No fresh-reset reproduction was attempted after timeout: 419 calls were already used, and replaying even the 288-label prefix would exceed the 700-call session cap.
action_sequence is an explicitly unverified compact candidate (288-label verified prefix plus 43 hypothesized L7 labels), not a claim that level 7 was reached.
